newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end up, seen rangebound in near term.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end up, seen rangebound in near term.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled higher amid light speculative buying and a dearth of selling, trading sources said.

The buying triggered buy stops which carried the spot July contract to the day's high of 77.80 cents a lb in early trade. Resistance was pegged at 80.00 cents, but the market is expected to trade sideways ahead of Friday's July options expiry, traders said.
Most-active July juice settled 0.65 cent higher at 76.85 cents after ranging from 77.80 to 76.00 cents. The rest closed up 0.70 to 1.10 in volume estimated at 2,500 lots.
Friday's official volume was pegged at 4,341 lots.
